browser: Claude desktop built-in browser: Chrome/156.0.8078.75 (Chromium). Safari, Firefox and file:// were not exercised; see limits.

a_info_links_and_popover.links_upgraded: role=button, aria-expanded=false, aria-controls=dt-pop on both links
a_info_links_and_popover.popover_content_cloned_from_guide_entry: title and both layers plus a 'More in Understand this report' link
a_info_links_and_popover.aria_expanded_reset_on_close: true, but only after the asynchronous toggle event (read 300 ms later); an immediate synchronous read still showed 'true'
a_info_links_and_popover.default_position: centred in the viewport by the user-agent popover style; placing it next to its trigger needs a few lines of script or CSS anchor positioning
a_info_links_and_popover.inside_same_origin_iframe: enhanced, both links upgraded, data image loaded (the app viewer shape)

a_fallback_without_script.how: same page with a wrong script hash, so the CSP blocks the enhancement
a_fallback_without_script.popover_element_hidden: display:none from the user-agent popover style, so the empty shell never shows

e_meta_csp.policy: default-src 'none'; img-src data:; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'sha256-<hash of the one inline script>'
e_meta_csp.json_data_island: not executed and not subject to script-src (WeasyPrint spike: not printed)
e_meta_csp.console: the browser logs one CSP violation per blocked injection; these are the expected evidence of blocking, not page errors
e_meta_csp.weasyprint: meta CSP is ignored by WeasyPrint without error (weasyprint_features.json)

limits: file:// could not be exercised: the desktop app opens local files as a static preview, not in the browser tab. Meta CSP is defined to apply to file:// documents, but that is not verified here.
Safari and Firefox were not exercised: only Safari is installed and driving it needs Remote Automation, a system setting that was not changed.
The design does not depend on these: info links are plain anchors first, and the popover enhancement only runs where HTMLElement.prototype.showPopover exists.
